IC1: Patients aged [OR] greater than 18 years of age
IC2: Ability to understand and willingness to comply with the study protocol
IC4: Patients meeting the Rotterdam PCOS workshop criteria for polycystic ovary syndrome, defined by oligomenorrhea [OR] or amenorrhea and at least one of the following two signs: clinical or biochemical evidence of hyperandrogenism [OR] or ultrasound [AND] finding of polycystic appearing ovaries.
